# brainstorm

Run brainstorming before building. Read
`docs/process/start-here.md` for setup/onboarding context and
`docs/process/workflow.md` for the Brainstorm phase. Ask a few targeted
questions, summarize assumptions, name trade-offs, and write the design using
the scaffold in `docs/process/design-template.md` — mark underspecified points
as `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: <question>]` instead of guessing, and resolve every
marker before approval.
